contentSummary: health_safety.html is a single-idea text page: a shared banner reading "Health & Safety" followed by one centred headline and an eleven-item accordion listing the group's safety commitments — safety as a core value, alignment with the Hong Kong International Convention and ISO 45001, task-level risk assessments, mandatory PPE, internal and external training, a documented emergency response plan, protocols for hazardous-material removal, periodic health check-ups and wellness programmes, transparent near-miss and incident reporting, audit-driven continuous improvement, and a shared safety culture. Every claim is qualitative — there is not a single number, date, certificate reference, named…

Accordion open/close is driven by JS writing inline style.maxHeight = scrollHeight + 'px', fighting the CSS max-height: 0 transition. Panels break on viewport resize or font reflow while open.

Zero elements in the body. images/health.jpg and images/health_safety.jpg exist in the repo and are never used on the Health & Safety page.
